scopeReview: CED FUN-4.A.9–10 relating graphical, numerical and analytic derivative features to function sketches. Five original graphs explicitly labeled f or f′; no missing image references. Derivative heights distinguished from slopes, sign crossings from touches, and transformations from original heights.
varietyReview: Flat original segment slope, derivative crossings, parabola-to-line sketch, decreasing concave-up shape, corner derivative gap, vertical translation, reflected input, derivative peak versus original inflection, cubic derivative parabola, shared derivative family and constant-derivative endpoint change.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.

The checker uses the plotted interpolation directly, not copied polynomial roots. The derivative graph’s peak at 0 is not a maximum of the original function.
optionReview: That crossing is negative to positive and gives a local minimum.
